name: exam-results-monitoring-system
description: Examination Results Monitoring System - Department of Computing, Faculty of Applied Sciences, Rajarata University of Sri Lanka
author: Syntax Squad

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('server/.env')) { fs.copyFileSync('server/.env.example', 'server/.env'); console.log('Created server/.env from template.'); } else { console.log('server/.env already exists.'); }"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
